branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A ready-to-drink flavoured milkshake sold mainly in the UK, in flavours such as strawberry and chocolate. It was launched in 1993 by Dairy Crest and has been made by Müller since 2015.

sources.text: Its flavours, launch and owners, from it.
